deadline.value: December 1, 11:59 pm Eastern (year inferred from the 2026-27 cycle).

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required and scores you send are not reviewed.
gre_general.quote: We do not require the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test. If you submit GRE scores we will not include them in the review of your application.

toefl_min.value: BBS requires at least 5.0 on the new TOEFL scale (100 on the pre-2026 iBT); test no later than November.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: We require a score of at least 5.0 (or 100 on the pre-2026 exam).

ielts_min.value: IELTS is accepted and BBS sets no minimum score; a speaking score of 7.5 or below means a summer English program at Yale.
ielts_min.quote: There is no minimum score requirement for the IELTS.

supervisor.value: You apply to a BBS track and rotate through three labs in the first year before choosing a thesis adviser.
supervisor.quote: We will require you to rotate through three labs during your first year of study to help you explore your research interests and find a thesis adviser.

funding.value: Every PhD student gets full tuition plus a stipend for at least five years.
funding.quote: Every PhD student receives a funding package that covers the full cost of tuition and provides a stipend to cover basic living costs like rent, food, and books — for a minimum of five years.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required to apply for a Yale PhD, so you can apply straight from a bachelor's (some programs prefer extra training).
entry_route.quote: A Master's degree is not required to apply for a PhD at Yale, although some programs give preference to applicants with post-baccalaureate training.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: One application for nine tracks (biochemistry, computational biology, genome sciences, immunology, microbiology, MCGD, neuroscience, plant molecular biology, translational medicine/pharmacology). The Plant Molecular Biology track strongly encourages contacting its faculty before applying.
